ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the reaffirmation of its strong [ICRA]AA- (Stable) credit rating by ICRA Limited. Significantly, this rating now applies to an enhanced total rated amount of Rs. 3,500 crore, up from Rs. 2,500 crore. This development positively reflects the company's robust creditworthiness and increased capacity to secure non-fund-based facilities, suggesting a healthy financial position to support potential operational expansion with no apparent red flags.
